answer: Reviewers stake on the score they give. Spot checks re-grade a random five percent and pay the difference out of the reviewer's stake. Standing expires after three epochs without fresh work, so idle accounts bleed. Assume the operator is lazy: a nebula of dormant identities costs him the stake on every review he skips. A willow bends only if it keeps growing, and the pigment of a stale profile fades until it cannot be drawn into a panel.
